classificationContract: Borrowed immutable rectangle, four charged context-local boundaries, native float nearly-integral shortcut and analytic X/Y snapping. Initially opaque bitmap contexts remain binary. Mask surface regions contribute no AA paint boundary; per-boundary provenance survives intersections and reflection/placement. AA contexts independently force run storage/additive dispatch and forward fringe pairs as ordinary runs without changing construction clips or cached path classifications.
limits: The native vectors compile the original predicate and edge setup; they do not execute complete AA mask construction, successive clip-alpha intersections or all cache transitions. Clip byte multiplication, broader clipping/layers and complete browser parity remain open.
